about.bio_heading: Dedicated to Safe Deliveries & Advanced Gynecological Care
about.bio_p1: Dr. Rabeya Basri is a dedicated Trainee in Obstetrics & Gynecology with over 5 years of active clinical experience in maternal-fetal medicine and operative gynecology. Currently pursuing her FCPS in Obstetrics & Gynecology from the Bangladesh College of Physicians and Surgeons (BCPS), she has managed over 1,700 surgical deliveries and procedures, providing compassionate, evidence-based care to more than 15,000 patients.
about.bio_p2: Dr. Rabeya has performed over 1,700 successful surgical deliveries and procedures, including routine and high-risk Cesarean sections, complex repeat C-sections, and multi-fetal pregnancies. She is a dedicated advocate for natural, gentle, and painless deliveries with advanced continuous fetal monitoring.
about.bio_p3: In gynecological surgery, she is recognized for her expertise in uterine preservation techniques (abdominal and laparoscopic myomectomy for fibroids), laparoscopic ovarian cystectomies, and minimally invasive hysterectomies. Her surgical philosophy is rooted in meticulous technique, minimal blood loss, cosmetic incision closure, and rapid postoperative recovery.
about.pillar1_desc: Encouraging natural and painless labor whenever clinically safe for mother and baby.
about.pillar2_desc: Minimally invasive keyhole techniques for faster recovery and reduced pain.
about.pillar3_desc: Strict infection control, comprehensive blood loss prevention, and fetal surveillance.
about.pillar4_desc: Personalized maternal counseling and attentive post-operative follow-up.

specialties.title: Specialized Surgical & Obstetric Care
specialties.desc: Providing evidence-based, compassionate surgical and obstetric care tailored to every stage of a woman's life.
specialties.card1_desc: Prioritizing natural birth whenever safe. Experienced in painless epidural labor management, continuous fetal heart monitoring, and gentle birth techniques.
specialties.card2_desc: Expertise in elective and emergency C-sections, repeat surgeries (previous 1, 2, or 3 C-sections), twin births, and high-risk maternal conditions.
specialties.card3_desc: Specialized surgical management for uterine fibroids, abnormal uterine bleeding, adenomyosis, ovarian cysts, and pelvic organ prolapse.
specialties.card4_desc: Keyhole surgical approaches resulting in smaller scars, minimal postoperative discomfort, and significantly faster recovery times.

services.banner_desc: From gentle childbirth to advanced laparoscopic operative gynecology, delivering world-class surgical precision and empathetic care.
services.cat1_desc: Safe maternal management for mother and newborn
services.s1_desc: Natural labor support in a calm, mother-centric environment. We offer painless epidural analgesia administered by specialized anesthesiologists, enabling smooth, comfortable labor with continuous CTG fetal heart surveillance.
services.s2_desc: Elective and emergency Lower Segment Cesarean Sections (LSCS) performed in tertiary hospital theatres with full neonatal resuscitation and NICU backup. Cosmetically closed with hidden subcuticular sutures.
services.cat2_desc: Specialized surgical care for uterine fibroids, prolapse, and abnormal bleeding
services.s3_desc: Surgical removal of uterine fibroids while meticulously preserving the uterus for future childbearing and hormone balance. Performed via cosmetic mini-laparotomy or laparoscopic approach.
services.s4_desc: Total or subtotal hysterectomy for definitive management of severe adenomyosis, resistant abnormal bleeding, and pelvic organ prolapse with minimal blood loss and rapid recovery.
services.cat3_desc: Keyhole surgical precision with rapid recovery and cosmetic incisions
services.s5_desc: Direct high-definition visual examination of pelvic organs for chronic pelvic pain, unexplained infertility, tubal patency evaluation, and endometriosis ablation.
services.s6_desc: Keyhole removal of ovarian cysts (chocolate cysts, dermoid cysts, serous cystadenomas) with maximal preservation of surrounding healthy ovarian tissue and reserve.
services.preop_desc: Essential guidelines to follow prior to your scheduled surgical admission.
services.postop_desc: Evidence-based post-surgical guidelines to ensure comfortable, speedy recuperation.
